newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shohkoh Fund to offer 1 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Shohkoh Fund to offer 1 mln new shares.

text.p: Shohkoh Fund & Co Ltd said on Thursday it would offer one million new shares and 474,100 shares in a secondary offering.

The financing company for small and medium-sized businesses said in a statement that it would offer the one million new, common shares to overseas investors. The payment date for the shares is June 27, 1997.

Shohkoh Fund said that subject to market conditions, 300,000 of the 474,100 shares offered in the secondary offering will be targetted at domestic investors. The remaining shares will be offered to institutional investors overseas.
The delivery date of the shares is June 30, 1997, it said.
The offer prices for both the new shares and the secondary offering will be decided between June 5 and June 11.
